Run

A run of the engine.

pub struct Run {
    /// The name of the run.
    pub name: String,

    /// The limit, when there is one.
    pub limit: Option<u32>,

    /// When the run started.
    pub started: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,

    chat: ChatDispatch,
}

impl Run {
    /// The largest run.
    pub const MAX: u32 = 9;

    /// Starts a run.
    pub fn start(name: String) -> Run;

    /// Stops it.
    pub fn stop(&mut self);
}
